title: Visual pigments and colour vision in a nocturnal bird, Strix aluco (tawny owl)
why: Microspectrophotometry of the tawny owl's cones (peaks at 463, 503 and 555 nm), its oil droplets and the absence of intact red-droplet cones; the owl view's cone and oil-droplet values rest on this paper as Hoglund 2019 reports them.
